about: OCG-authored RFC 8785 probes (first-party, CC BY 4.0). Each input is JSON text, parsed with JSON.parse so a member named __proto__ is an ordinary own member. expected is the RFC 8785 serialization, written by hand from RFC 8785 §3.2.3 (member names sorted by UTF-16 code unit).

probes.why: array-index member names: JS enumerates them numerically, RFC 8785 sorts them as strings
mixed array-index and ordinary member names
year-style keys, the shape a fintech table would carry
"01" is an ordinary string key and "1" is an array index; RFC 8785 puts "01" first
UTF-16 order puts U+1F602 (surrogate D83D) before U+FB33; UTF-8 byte order reverses them
regression for the null-prototype fix: a member named __proto__ must survive canonicalization
